hypothesis: Jerome's consolidated note (30 Sep 2026) names the metrics the field benchmark should carry beside the score error: C(r), correlation length, kink density, domain-length distribution, marginal bimodality, generated-sample quality; and the clean-data maximum likelihood of the pair energy as the no-noising baseline (Marc's remark). This experiment supplies them on E33's cells and streams, so each row pairs with E33's.
design: physics_truth (deterministic, laptop): per cell and rep, 4096 exact stationary chains; kink density per bond and per unit length, interior domain lengths, C(r) against the spectral sum, kurtosis against the exact one, barrier mass. clean (cluster, one job): per (cell, seed, M) the four kernel arms of E33 fitted by clean-data maximum likelihood on E33's training chains (same tag/seed/cell/M), a short checkpoint ladder selected on E33's validation bundle (BP risk), scored on E33's test bundle with E33's estimand and the kernel's invariant law as initial law. physics_learned (after E33): ancestral samples on the grid from every risk-selected E33 kernel at M = 2048, seeds 0-3, started from the kernel's own invariant law, same statistics against the truth.

predeclared_predictions.P1: exact samples reproduce the spectral C(r) within Monte Carlo error on every cell: the largest |C_sample(r) - C_spectral(r)| over lags is below 3.5 standard errors, the standard error of each lag taken from the scatter of per-chain means over 4096 independent chains (the max over 32-128 lags makes 3 too tight); and the physical kink density (per unit length) stays within 20% across the three refinement cells, which describe one physical system.
predeclared_predictions.P2: clean-data MLE beats one-view EM at every M for every kernel arm (16/16 paired), the gap shrinking with M; for the tilted kernels the clean-data risk at M = 2048 is below 0.02 pooled on every cell.
predeclared_predictions.P3: the mixture kernel's clean-data fit does not reach the tilted kernels' at M = 2048 on any cell: misspecification, not the channel, limits it.
predeclared_predictions.P4: samples from the fitted tilted-spline kernel reproduce the truth's kink density and mean domain length within 15% at M = 2048 on every cell; samples from the fitted mixture kernel overshoot the kink density (a linear drift cannot hold a domain).
predeclared_predictions.P1b: Amendment of 1 Oct 2026 after P1's second half was falsified and BEFORE the coarse statistic was computed: the coarse kink density per unit length (every run shorter than the kink width sqrt(2), i.e. sqrt(2)/h sites, merged into its neighbours) is within 20% across the three refinement cells, and the coarse mean domain length in physical units is within 20%.

predeclared_analysis: physics.csv: sample vs spectral rows per cell. clean.csv joined to E33's kernels.csv on (cell, seed, n_chains, arm, test_bundle): paired ratio noisy/clean per arm and M with the exact bootstrap. learned.csv: per (cell, arm) kink density and mean domain length relative to the truth row of the same (cell, seed).
